'''0.14f''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various crashes and synchronization errors.

==Changelog==
* Fixed out of sync during a sudden FPS drop
* Fixed several crashes when joining a match
* Fixed a crash after a match
* Fixed swallowing start sound when firing bursts
* Fixed a bug in applying a penalty to the dispersion with broken arms
